purpose: Evaluate independent creative output, not responsiveness to scene-specific coaching.

controls: Use separate clean sessions for baseline and candidate, with identical user prompts and model settings.
Record actual bundle hash, model, settings, run IDs and complete outputs. If a baseline bundle is unavailable, label the test candidate-only.
Do not send reviewer criteria, examples, previous feedback or the other output to the generating model.
Blind reviewers to bundle version and randomize display order; disclose when the reviewer is also the author.
Compare first outputs before allowing repairs. Report coached repairs separately.
Keep script creation/review, full video-prompt review, and generation-constraint adaptation as separate evaluation stages. Never infer an upstream script defect from a mixed prompt-review result.

Request only the deliverable of the selected stage. Ask for a separate shot plan only when that stage requires it; do not ask for start/end fields on every gesture. Preserve explicitly requested synchronization.
Use evidence-backed pairwise preferences and unmet constraints, not invented quality percentages.
Do not infer audiovisual quality from text-only performance. Do not declare success on one sample.

cases.prompt: 写一部约30秒的现代生活轻喜剧短片剧本，地点是深夜自助洗衣店，出场两位成年人。冲突、人物关系与结尾由你创作，开场前三秒要有能看见或听见的吸引点。只交付标题和剧本正文，动作自然连贯，台词标明说话人。不写分镜、逐动作时间表、生成提示词、创作说明或自评分。不调用工具、不写文件、不生成媒体。
reviewer_checks: The opening presents a concrete situation that creates curiosity, not merely a title or an explanation of the hook.
Character choices grow from a readable objective and obstacle; the turn does not require an unestablished fact.
The ending develops or pays off the setup through action or dialogue rather than an appended moral.
Dialogue, prop continuity and action load plausibly fit the requested runtime with room for reaction.
Judge readiness for storyboarding only. Do not infer visual quality, an audience retention percentage, or general skill improvement.

cases.prompt: 写一部约40秒的生活悬疑短片剧本，地点是住宅楼电梯口，出场两位成年人。冲突、人物关系与结尾由你创作，开场前三秒要有能看见或听见的吸引点。只交付标题和剧本正文，动作自然连贯，台词标明说话人。不写分镜、逐动作时间表、生成提示词、创作说明或自评分。不调用工具、不写文件、不生成媒体。
reviewer_checks: The opening establishes an observable discrepancy or tension; information is revealed in a coherent order.
Characters react to what they can know, without arbitrary stupidity or author-only knowledge.
The ending changes the meaning of an established detail or resolves/deepens the established conflict, not an unrelated last-line surprise.
The elevator, people and relevant props retain coherent states; legitimate uncertainty is not treated as a mandatory exposition gap.
Judge script-level clarity and interest with runtime plausibility, not video prompt syntax or rendered-film quality.

cases.scope_note: Historical input mixes a story outline with an unscoped generation restriction. Retained for traceability; its cast-conflict response is not evidence of negative-template injection into script creation.
cases.prompt: 审查下面30秒动作喜剧提纲，简短指出影响理解的连接问题及最小修正方向，不重写整片、不生成媒体。镜头1：女子提杂货袋行走，男子骑滑板车按铃让她让路。镜头2：车自己滚回来，男子在后追。镜头3：女子用脚拦车，男子说“你拦住它了？”，她说“不客气”。镜头4：男子的袋子掉开，女子接住散落蔬菜，老邻居笑。镜头5：男子骑走，才发现头盔在女子手里，转身回来。全片保持角色和环境一致，无额外人物、不可能物理。不要假定未写出的机制已经发生。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Identifies missing basis for scooter return without claiming a slope or motor behaviour was already established.
Tracks ownership of the two grocery bags and missing helmet transfer; does not demand every trivial gesture be filmed.

Reports ambiguity between the planned neighbour and the unscoped generation restriction. Do not score this mixed-input response as a script-creation regression or automatic deletion of project characters.
Discusses action/dialogue load without inventing mandatory per-gesture timestamps or changing the ending.

cases.prompt: 只审查故事连接，不重写整片、不生成媒体。30秒动作喜剧提纲：女子提杂货袋行走，男子骑滑板车按铃让她让路；车自己滚回来，男子在后追；女子用脚拦车，男子说“你拦住它了？”，她说“不客气”；男子的袋子掉开，女子接住散落蔬菜，老邻居笑；男子骑走，才发现头盔在女子手里，转身回来。请指出影响理解的连接问题和最小修正方向。未写明的动作机制不要当成已经发生。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Evaluates scooter motion, bag ownership and missing helmet transfer from story facts only.
Does not invent a two-person limit or generation-negative restriction; the neighbour is already a planned story character.
Distinguishes an actual missing connection from ordinary ellipsis and from an unverified generation difficulty.

cases.prompt: 剧情已经确认，计划角色为女子、男子和老年邻居，各镜出场按分镜名单执行。生成模板中有一句通用限制“无额外人物”。现在只整理这句生成约束在本项目中的作用范围，不写剧本、不修改角色名单、不生成媒体、不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Scopes the restriction to unplanned people or duplicates while respecting each shot's approved cast.
Does not require all three characters in every shot and does not delete the neighbour or rewrite the story.
This tests downstream constraint adaptation, not script creation or measured video quality.

cases.prompt: 审查这个明确的回忆转场方案，不重写故事：现在的破屋里，成年女子把红玩具推到受伤的猫前。硬切到过去的晴天球场，保持玩具在画面中的位置、低机位和猫的身份花纹，但猫健康、女子无伤。猫抓住玩具，下镜女子直接拿玩具抛出，猫追出、抓住、带回、放下并得到抚摸，全部安排在3秒。分别说出哪些连续性成立、哪些需补连接、哪些是执行风险。只输出文字，不调用工具、不生成媒体。
reviewer_checks: Accepts the explicit past/present scene and health-state changes, distinguishing identity from transient state.
Preserves the local match-cut anchors instead of freezing the entire environment.
Detects the missing return/transfer of the toy to the woman.
Flags the three-second multi-action burden without rejecting all animal action or rewriting the flashback into a different story.

cases.prompt: 写一段20秒的克制生活短片：末班车站台，一位年轻成年人接到熟人的电话，对方只说“你不用等了。”他回答“嗯”，挂断后看了一眼身旁空着的长凳位置，仍把那个位置留着。末班车从背景离开，他没有上车。只出现这一个画内人物，电话中的人不出镜。前三秒有可感知的关系变化，风格服从故事，不强制DV。先交付简洁剧本，再给最多三镜的分镜方案（每镜计划时长、动作、声音、切镜理由），保留两句原文。直接创作，不需要另做大纲或询问，不调用工具、不生图、不生成视频。
reviewer_checks: The script describes motivation, causal actions and recognition rather than timestamping every hand or gaze movement.
Only the shot plan and justified synchronization cues use numeric timing; the twenty-second runtime and opening hook remain intact.
Preserves the phone speaker, exact dialogue, empty seat and decision not to board; no added person or exposition.
Does not force equal shot lengths or mechanically map each narrative beat to a cut.

cases.prompt: 写一个10秒的单镜短片方案：成年人在桌边等电话，第4秒电话响，他停下翻书，第6秒按用户指定的音乐重拍合上书，再接电话但不说话。保留4秒铃声和6秒合书这两个同步要求，其余表演自然展开。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Retains the user-specified four-second ring and six-second book closure, rather than deleting all timestamps.
Keeps one shot and causal action continuity without inventing micro-action timing for every gesture.

cases.prompt: 写一场24秒、最多四镜的荒诞职场喜剧导演稿：一名能轻松暂停时间的图书管理员，把正在倒下的书架停在半空。读者急着赶火车，她从容让读者补签借阅单。读者签完，她才恢复时间，接住掉下的一本书。保留能力、结局和从容反差，不增加角色或道具。给逐镜时长、动作、对白、声源和切镜理由。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Preserves effortless time control rather than manufacturing physical struggle.
Makes the reader's urgency and librarian's composure visible through timing and behaviour.
Tracks the form, book, hands and frozen state across cuts.
Allocates plausible dialogue and reaction time; cuts have a narrative purpose.

cases.prompt: 写一场30秒、最多五镜的悬疑导演稿：值班保安从监控看见走廊尽头的门正在缓缓打开。他转头看同一扇门，门却关着；再看监控，画面时间比墙上时钟早两分钟。结尾只有现实门锁传来一声轻响。保持信息揭示顺序，不出现袭击者，不增加解释性对白、惊吓音效或新道具。给逐镜时长、站位视线、动作与声源。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Viewer and guard learn the time discrepancy only after comparing the doors.
Screen and real corridor are distinguishable without explaining the twist in dialogue.
Final lock sound is located in the real space; no prematurely revealed attacker.
Framing and duration build uncertainty rather than relying on generic ominous adjectives.

cases.prompt: 写一场20秒、最多四镜的克制家庭戏导演稿：兄弟在旧房门口分别。哥哥右手提工具箱，左手握唯一一把钥匙；弟弟双手扶着拆下的门牌。哥哥把钥匙留给弟弟，说“锁还好使”，弟弟回答“知道”。哥哥离开前停半步，但不回头。不要增加道具、角色、哭泣、拥抱或其他对白。给逐镜时长、动作、声源和结束状态。只输出文字，不调用工具。
reviewer_checks: Accounts for occupied hands when transferring the key without losing the sign or toolbox.
Preserves the specified dialogue, pause and absence of a backward look.
Conveys relationship through choices and timing rather than adding exposition.
Establishes a readable doorway and consistent exit direction.
